feeds.title: California Review of Books
feeds.description: California Review of Books offers readers smart, concise, and timely reviews of new books, along with regular reviews of older books that we think deserve another look. Blogger authors and reviewers Brian Tanguay and David Starkey consider books from all over the world but often focus on titles published in their home state.

feeds.title: Read Her Like An Open Book
feeds.description: Let's celebrate literary fiction by women! Read Her Like An Open Book Bill Wolfe uncovers the bias against Female-written novels and offers stark, objective takes on many contemporary titles. Explore the reviews, commentary, and opinions on recent novels in the genre here.

feeds.title: The Reading Diaries
feeds.description: Mandy is a book-obsessed coffee-drinking crafty nerd living in Northern California. Her bookish blog 'The Reading Diaries, chronicles her thoughts and reflections on whatever she reads. Her passion for reading and discussing stories has given way to the blog where she offers reviews, author posts, giveaways, and more!

feeds.title: Chick Lit Book Café
feeds.description: Chick Lit Café is passionate about books and the reading experience. The team's goal is to provide readers with the very best hand-picked fiction books written by remarkable and talented authors who have over-the-top captivating imaginations, outstanding writing abilities, and unique stories to tell.

feeds.title: Author Anthony Avina
feeds.description: Author Anthony Avina is a writer for the online company TheGamer, a video creator on YouTube, and working towards being a full-time author. He writes a variety of books, from YA and horror to science fiction and drama. He is currently working on his next self-published book and his first traditionally published book Now.

feeds.title: Lina Sivertsen - Book Mama Blog
feeds.description: Linda Sivertsen, the guiding force behind BookMama, invites readers to explore a realm where birthing book babies parallels human endeavour. As a bestselling author, teacher, and idea-fairy, Linda captivates with her insights and creativity. Through her blog, she keeps enthusiasts abreast of her latest musings, book events, and more, offering a vibrant space for literary exploration and inspiration.

feeds.title: Cybils Blog
feeds.description: Children's and Young Adult Bloggers' Literary Awards (Cybils) is a literary event seeking out and recognizing books that portray diversity, inclusion, and appropriate representation for children and teens. Here you'll their latest updates on Judges, Categories, Panels and more.

feeds.title: Kids Lit Book Cafe
feeds.description: Reviewing, Promoting, Featuring & Recommending the Most Incredible Children's Books for All Ages & All Genres. Authors Submit Your Book For our Book Review & Promotion Services

feeds.title: Simone and Her Books
feeds.description: I'm Simone and I like books. I'm a full time blogger living in Los Angeles, CA. I'm also a book reviewer for Publishers Weekly. A friend of mine once told me that you can't finish a book until you've written about it. This is where I have my bookish thoughts. You'll find book reviews, recommendations, fun bookish accessories, and thoughts triggered by what I read and see.

feeds.title: Reading Litty
feeds.description: Reading Litty by Daniel is a book blog featuring a delectable collection of book reviews and titles. It is also a safe space to talk about the books that inspire lives, that are creating controversy, and that speak about topics that need to be brought to light. Daniel lives in San Diego, and loves to jog other than reading.

feeds.title: Rockstar Book Tours
feeds.description: Jaime and Rachel, We decided to start Rockstar Book Tours because we love books, the authors behind the books - they are our rockstars - and blog tours. And we wanted to be able to provide a service - free of charge - that would allow us to promote the authors and books we love.

feeds.title: Reader Voracious Blog
feeds.description: You will find bookish discussions, lists of upcoming releases, and guides & resources for readers/bloggers. As an advocate for reading diversely and all of my reviews will list representation in the book, as well as content/trigger warnings.

feeds.title: The Bibliofile Blog
feeds.description: The Bibliofile is a book review, summary and news site focusing on Bestsellers, New Releases, Popular Nonfiction, Literary Fiction and Mystery/Thrillers. Discover your next favorite read.

feeds.title: Lost In A Good Book
feeds.description: It's easy to get lost in a new favorite book. The problem is where do you find the next great read once you've finished and found your way back home? I hope that reviews of the books I've read will help others to find something new to love. My tastes vary but lately I've been into Fantasy, Women's Lit, Classic Lit, YA, Dystopian, and Children's books.

feeds.title: Read This, Not That Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Abby. Welcome to my blog. I live in Sacramento, California. When I'm not working, spending time with family and friends, cooking, or running, I'm an avid reader. Find Book Reviews, Quotes, and Musings from a Fiction Fangirl.

feeds.title: Silent Book Club Blog » California
feeds.description: Read all articles, event updates and other exciting stuff from the Silent Book Club tagged California. The Silent Book Club is a global community of readers and introverts, with 300 chapters around the world led by local volunteers.

feeds.title: Los Angeles Review of Books
feeds.description: The Los Angeles Review of Books is a nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting and disseminating rigorous, incisive, and engaging writing on every aspect of literature, culture, and the arts. It seeks to revive and reinvent the book review for the internet age and remains committed to covering and representing today's diverse literary and cultural landscape.

feeds.title: UC Press Blog
feeds.description: Read blogs categorized under Ecology Earth Systems, Advances in Global Health, Anthropology, Archaeology, Art, and more. UC Press is one of the most forward-thinking scholarly publishers in the nation, committed to driving progressive change by seeking out and cultivating the brightest minds and giving them a voice, reach, and impact.
